chapters.title: The Wet Map
chapters.objective: Lin must obtain Bo's dry map from Aunt He's tea stall before Yan's witnesses reach the flooded market, while concealing the lantern and deciding whether to tell Bo what opening it costs.
chapters.conflict: Bo will not leave unless Lin promises to protect Mei.
chapters.state_change: Lin learns the bridge will close earlier because of the flood.
chapters.hook: A river voice repeats a promise in Lin's own voice.

chapters.title: Archive Stairs
chapters.objective: Lin and Bo reach the archive stairwell, give Mei the map, and force Mei to reveal why Yan's sister was placed inside the lantern's debt record before the second bell.
chapters.conflict: Mei refuses to reveal the ledger entry while Bo is present.
chapters.state_change: Mei confirms the debt was transferred by an archivist, not the guild.
chapters.hook: Yan sends a bargain written in water across the map.

chapters.title: Third Bell
chapters.objective: Lin confronts Yan at the bridge with the sealed lantern and the ledger proof, chooses between exposing Mei's past transfer or saving Bo from the rising flood, and ends with a concrete unresolved cost.
chapters.conflict: Yan offers Lin the erased debt in exchange for the lantern before the third bell.
chapters.state_change: The group learns whose memory will be erased if the lantern opens.
chapters.hook: The third bell begins to ring as the lantern seal cracks but does not open.
